to certain statutory provisions, if the acquirer, together with its affiliates, holds at least the amount of shares of each class of stock of the target corporation that would otherwise be required to
approve a merger for the target corporation, and the other stockholders of the target corporation receive the same consideration for their stock in the merger as was payable in the tender offer, then
the acquirer can effect a merger without the action of the other stockholders of the target corporation.
